evals.name: rules-pass-includes-itself
evals.expected_output: Launches the three inventory packets as read-only workers in one message, assigns every hook and inline entry its prune flags including the ones in this skill's own files and the parity suite, and routes each verdict through AskUserQuestion before changing anything.
assertions: Three read-only workers launched in parallel
Does not exempt its own SKILL.md or the parity suite from the pass
Flags use the lenses: dead, redundant owner, overlap, over-reach, untested deny, silent rule
No change applied without a user decision

evals.name: filters-synthetic-user-turns
evals.prompt: Suggest new hooks from my recent transcripts.
evals.expected_output: Extracts user turns with the jq recipe, drops turns holding task-notification, SYSTEM NOTIFICATION, command-name, local-command, ide_selection, 'Stop hook feedback' or 'Base directory for this skill' markers, and counts only the remaining correction-shaped turns as evidence.
assertions: Applies the seven-marker filter before the correction regex
Does not count a hook's own feedback text as a user correction
Reports the sampled turn count and the filtered count

evals.name: writes-a-brief-per-approved-candidate
evals.prompt: Two candidates were approved: deny gh pr merge --admin, and deny eslint --fix.
evals.expected_output: Writes one brief per approved candidate at ~/.claude/plans/hook-<slug>.md following the six-heading template, with the evidence, the event and matcher, the fixture cases and the commit shape, and builds no hook in this run.
assertions: One brief file per approved candidate
Each brief carries the six headings of the template
No hook script or wiring entry is written in this run
The closing report lists each brief path next to its candidate

evals.name: gather-returns-both-tables-and-asks-nothing
evals.prompt: Run hooks-review with the argument gather.
evals.expected_output: Runs the inventory, assigns flags and recommended verdicts, builds the candidate table, returns both tables and makes no AskUserQuestion call, no brief and no file change.
assertions: No hook, wiring file, fixture or brief is written
Both tables carry a recommended verdict per row

evals.name: apply-reads-verdicts-and-skips-the-chain
evals.prompt: Run hooks-review with the argument apply /tmp/verdicts.md, where the file holds one verdict per hook and per candidate.
evals.expected_output: Skips both interviews, applies the prune verdicts with their fixture cases, writes one brief per approved candidate, commits per concern, prints the closing report and stops: no codex adversarial review, no /doctor recommendation.
assertions: Verdicts come from the file, not from a new interview
The closing report is produced and the chain is not run
